subject.title: Feature request: add prefix/list-style skill discovery to ClawHub CLI search

question: Should ClawHub formalize deterministic `exact` and `prefix` modes in the public skill-search API and expose them as CLI flags?
rationale: The request adds a lasting public API and CLI contract whose ordering, result limits, and enumeration guarantees require maintainer intent rather than an automated implementation choice.

options.title: Adopt exact and prefix modes
options.body: Preserve ranked search as the default and add explicit deterministic modes with documented ordering and result limits.

options.title: Add prefix mode only
options.body: Provide family enumeration through prefix search while directing exact slug lookup through the existing inspect/detail path.

options.title: Retain current discovery paths
options.body: Keep ranked search, bounded explore, and direct inspect as separate workflows without promising complete prefix enumeration.

recommendation.title: Adopt exact and prefix modes
recommendation.body: Preserve ranked search as the default and add explicit deterministic modes with documented ordering and result limits.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the strongest available merged-history connection to exact-slug fallback and backend search behavior.
